title: fix(cli): four more read-only sentences name what they vouch for, and the journal-mode switch on a SQLite file
body:
Fixes #23899
Clause-②: no

The remainder of #23726, by the pattern PR #23608, PR #23725 and PR #23895 set. Four sentences, printed by three commands after their boot, said that nothing was written. On a SQLite file still on a rollback journal, that boot's connect switches the journal mode, which rewrites the file header and no row. Each sentence now names what it vouches for, and on a SQLite target the line that carries it is followed by the exported `JOURNAL_MODE_SWITCH_NOTE`: "Opening a SQLite file can still switch its journal mode (to WAL by default), which changes its header only."

The basis for `Clause-②: no` is the claim's: operator text only. No flag, exit code, prompt, refusal, accepted input or export signature moves, no `--json` document gains or loses a key, and there is no `packages/spec` edit.

## The premise, measured at the door, before and after

The real CLI through `packages/cli/bin/run-dev.js` (tsx), with `@objectstack/objectql` rebuilt at each sha. Before: `bb14934cd` (base). After: `c4adb868c` (this head). Every run got its own copy of the fixture and a fresh `OS_HOME`, with the database env vars unset. Header bytes 18 and 19 are the journal mode (1,1 rollback journal; 2,2 WAL); the counter is bytes 24 to 27. "Content" is an md5 over the schema plus every row of every table, read on a connection of my own.

- CRM fixture: `examples/app-crm` compiled with `os build`, provisioned by `os migrate apply --yes`, plus one `sys_legacy_widget` table with one row, then put on `journal_mode = delete` (72 tables, 1 row).
- Row 2 runs from a directory whose `objectstack.config.ts` carries one plugin: its `kernel:ready` hook calls `create()` on the driver (2a) or `execute('SELECT count(*) FROM sys_metadata')` (2b).
- Row 4: an empty directory, a file provisioned by one `os secret rewrap --apply --yes`, then put on `journal_mode = delete` (10 tables, 2 rows).

| # | Run | Header 18,19 · counter | Content | Printed before | Printed after |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `os migrate plan` (CRM) | 1,1 · 5 to 2,2 · 6 (both shas) | unchanged | "They are reported for information only — nothing here drops them, and a plan writes nothing." | "… and a plan writes no row or table." plus the note |
| 2a | `os migrate plan`, a plugin write refused | 1,1 · 5 to 2,2 · 6 (both) | unchanged | "Refused 1 write(s) during the declaration boot — a plan writes nothing: create() on sys_metadata. …" | "… — a plan writes no row or table: create() on sys_metadata. …" plus the note at the end of that note's line |
| 2b | `os migrate plan`, a raw read forwarded | 1,1 · 5 to 2,2 · 6 (both) | unchanged | "… If those commands only read, nothing was written; if one wrote, it landed. …" | "… If those commands only read, no row or table was written; if one wrote, it landed. …" plus the note at the end of that note's line |
| 3 | `os migrate summary-nulls --recompute-undefined-on-empty crm_account.nope`, dry run and `--apply --yes` (CRM) | 1,1 · 5 to 2,2 · 6 (both modes, both shas) | unchanged | "… Refused before any row was read; nothing was written." | "… Refused before the walk read or wrote any row." plus the note |
| 4 | `os secret rewrap --apply --yes --no-declared-datasources`, a finished re-run (0 re-wrapped) | 1,1 · 4 to 2,2 · 5 (both) | unchanged | "… and a finished run writes nothing." | "… and a finished run writes no sys_secret row." plus the note |
| 4 | the same, dry run | 1,1 · 4 to 2,2 · 5 (both) | unchanged | as above | "… writes no sys_secret row." The closing line already carries the note (PR #23725) |

All four rows print after the connect, so none of them was left as it was. Rows 2 and 3 were read, not measured, on the card; they are measured here for the first time.

**The `--json` doors.** `os migrate plan --json` carries the guard note in `composition.notes` (row 2a measured: the new sentence, no note; key set identical to base, 22 keys). The unmanaged-table section is the `unmanagedTables` report object and carries no sentence. `os migrate summary-nulls --json` carries the engine's refusal in `error` (the new sentence, no note; `code: INVALID_FIELD`, `httpStatus: 400`). `os secret rewrap --json` carries `report.notes[1]` (the new sentence, no note), in both modes; the key set and the notes' count and order are identical to base.

**A non-SQLite target, at the door:** `os migrate plan --database-url :memory:` from the 2a directory prints the 2a sentence with no note (0 occurrences). The pins below add the PostgreSQL case for every text.

## Why two sentences name a narrower noun than "no row or table"

Two runs boot plain, not read-only, and that boot writes on a database that has never been started. Measured at base on a fresh file (one placeholder table, rollback journal):

- `os migrate summary-nulls --apply --yes --recompute-undefined-on-empty crm_account.nope`: 1 table to 14 tables, rows unchanged, then the refusal.
- `os secret rewrap --apply --yes --no-declared-datasources` with nothing to re-wrap (a finished run, exit 0): 1 table to 11 tables and 1 row to 3 (two `sys_migration` rows), and the "Re-running is safe" note printed.

So "no row or table" would be false there. Row 3 now vouches for the walk ("Refused before the walk read or wrote any row."), which is what `backfillSummaryNulls` controls, and row 4 for the rows the re-wrap writes ("a finished run writes no sys_secret row"). Both are true in either mode. Rows 1 and 2 are printed only by `os migrate plan`, whose boot defers DDL and opens no missing file, so they claim no row or table.

## How the note reaches each line

The test is the one PR #23725 uses: `describeDriverSqliteFile(stack.driver?.config) !== undefined` (`utils/connection-display.ts`, read and not edited). The note is appended by the command that prints the line, in the text output only. No parameter was added anywhere, so no export signature moves.

- **Rows 1 and 2, `migrate/plan.ts`.** The composition notes and the unmanaged-table section are printed through one helper: a line that claims "no row or table" is followed by the note on a SQLite file. That is how the command finds the guard's note among the composition notes without a new export from the guard; the pin feeds it the REAL guard's text, so a guard rewording that drops the claim turns the pin red. The `--json` document is unchanged in shape.
- **Row 3, `migrate/summary-nulls.ts`.** The command's catch appends the note to an `INVALID_FIELD` error on a SQLite file. Inside that `try`, `INVALID_FIELD` has one producer: `backfillSummaryNulls`'s scope refusal (its only `throw`; the walk records failures rather than throwing, and the other refusals there are `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` or plain errors). Both modes. The `--json` envelope carries the engine's message as it is.
- **Row 4, `secret/rewrap.ts`.** `renderReport` takes a map from a note's text to what follows it; the "Re-running is safe" note gets the note under `--apply` on a SQLite file. A dry run's closing line already carries it, so there it carries none (one copy per run, pinned). `REWRAP_NOTES` stays loaded at the point of use, as before.

**`report.notes` readers, by `git grep` over the repo:** the resumable note's text had no reader outside its own definition and the docs mirror. `sys-secret-rewrap.test.ts`'s RESUMABLE case title names the executor's own writes (it asserts the store's write count), not this text, and is unchanged.

## The texts

| # | Where | FROM | TO |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `cli/src/utils/unmanaged-tables.ts:508` | "… and a plan writes nothing." | "… and a plan writes no row or table." |
| 2a | `cli/src/utils/schema-migration-plugins.ts:1148` | "— a plan writes nothing" | "— a plan writes no row or table" |
| 2b | `cli/src/utils/schema-migration-plugins.ts:1163` | "If those commands only read, nothing was written;" | "If those commands only read, no row or table was written;" |
| 3 | `objectql/src/summary-backfill.ts:300` | "Refused before any row was read; nothing was written." | "Refused before the walk read or wrote any row." |
| 4 | `cli/src/utils/sys-secret-rewrap.ts:507` (`REWRAP_NOTES.resumable`) and `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx:652` | "… and a finished run writes nothing." | "… and a finished run writes no sys_secret row." The docs mirror adds the SQLite note in one sentence. |

## Pins (one per text, a SQLite and a PostgreSQL case where the note is conditional)

- **Row 1:** `cli/src/utils/unmanaged-tables.test.ts` gains one case pinning the closing line byte for byte. `cli/src/commands/migrate/plan.journal-mode-note.test.ts` (new) runs the real command with the boot, the occupancy probe and the sweep's READ replaced (the renderer is real): SQLite gets exactly "line + note", PostgreSQL exactly the line and no note anywhere.
- **Row 2:** the same new file, for 2a and 2b, with each guard note produced by a real `createDeclarationBootWriteGuard()` armed over a fake driver, made to refuse one `create()` or forward one `execute()`, and disarmed. One more case pins `--json`: `composition.notes` equals the guard's note, and the document carries no note. In `schema-migration-plugins.declaration-boot-write-guard.test.ts`, every assertion on the old phrase moved to the new one, the negative ones included, so none of them went vacuous (11 occurrences); the raw-execute case now pins the 2b sentence itself. `schema-migrate.host-composition.integration.test.ts` and `schema-migrate.deferred-ddl.integration.test.ts` moved the same way.
- **Row 3:** `objectql/src/summary-backfill.test.ts`'s REFUSES case pins the closing sentence for all six refusal shapes. `cli/src/commands/migrate/summary-nulls.test.ts` gains five cases with the engine's REAL refusal (`vi.importActual`): dry run and `--apply`, each SQLite and PostgreSQL, and `--json` (the envelope's `error` is the engine's message, no note).
- **Row 4:** `cli/src/commands/secret/rewrap.guards.test.ts` gains four cases: `--apply` SQLite (the note follows the line), `--apply` PostgreSQL (no note), a dry run (the line carries none; the run carries the note once), and `--json` in both modes (`report.notes` holds the new text, no note).
- **Tier:** the new plan file value-imports `bootSchemaStack` to mock it, so `vitest-tiers.ts`'s KERNEL signal puts it in `integration`, beside `summary-nulls.test.ts` and `rewrap.guards.test.ts`.

## Ablation (one per wording)

At `c4adb868c`, one run under the verify lock: a baseline, then each new wording put back to its old text through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode) with an EXIT/INT/TERM trap restoring from `HEAD`, every pin file re-run in each leg (`objectql/src/summary-backfill.test.ts` plus the seven CLI pin files). Each leg: the anchor hit once and fell 1 to 0, the blob changed, and the restore was proven by blob equal to `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty and `git status --porcelain` empty.

| Leg | Blob | Red (only these) | Green |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | | none | objectql 20 of 20; CLI 13 files, 150 of 150 |
| 1 unmanaged-tables | `6add5c0c8d26` to `c647aec174bc` | 3: the render pin and both plan cases for the line | objectql 20; CLI 115 of 118 |
| 2a guard refusal | `498e46872d08` to `0fa153eef1a4` | 7: both plan cases for 2a, four guard cases, host-composition THE FIX | objectql 20; CLI 111 of 118 |
| 2b guard raw | `498e46872d08` to `e2786928219d` | 3: both plan cases for 2b, the guard's raw-execute case | objectql 20; CLI 115 of 118 |
| 3 summary-backfill | `2fb88f18451d` to `f83de26a8bc2` | 1: objectql REFUSES | CLI 118 of 118 |
| 4 rewrap resumable | `3db476f2ebce` to `ec49817fb26f` | 4: the four new rewrap cases | objectql 20; CLI 114 of 118 |

Leg 3's CLI cases stayed green, as expected: they read the engine's refusal through `@objectstack/objectql`'s `exports`, so `dist/`, which this source mutation did not rebuild. The text's pin is the objectql one, which resolves `src/`. The CLI cases pin the note's follow-through, not the text. No other leg needed a rebuild: every other subject is the CLI's own `src`, reached by relative import.

## Verification (head `c4adb868c`)

- **Build:** `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/cli^...' --concurrency=2`: 60 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0; then `@objectstack/objectql` rebuilt after the edit (14 tasks, VERDICT 0). The new sentence is in `objectql/dist/index.js` and `index.mjs` (1 hit each; the old one: 0).
- **Tests:** the touched CLI files by path (8 files, 132 tests passed, VERDICT 0); the baseline leg above (objectql `summary-backfill.test.ts` 20 of 20; CLI 13 files including the four `plan.*.integration.test.ts`, `rewrap.driver-contract.test.ts` and `sys-secret-rewrap.test.ts`, 150 of 150). These are integration-tier files, run by path; the rest of that tier is declared to CI. The CLI unit tier (`vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`): Test Files 307 passed (307), Tests 4574 passed (4574), exit 0. `@objectstack/objectql` (`vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`): Test Files 436 passed (436), Tests 8229 passed (8229), exit 0.
- **Typecheck:** `@objectstack/cli` exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck` held at 3 files, 28 errors, 6 signatures); `@objectstack/objectql` exit 0 (held at 39 files, 233 errors, 64 signatures). `tsc --listFilesOnly -p tsconfig.json` puts all seven touched CLI test files in its 1607-file program.
- **Lint, by the narrowing:** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the 15 changed `.ts` files exited 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- **Gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 99 commands from merge base `bb14934cd` (17 paths, 506 changed lines). All 99 ran at `c4adb868c`, each exit captured before any pipe. 94 exited 0 on the first run; five refused on a prerequisite (exit 3: no built `dist/` for the CLI, some plugins or `client-react`) and exited 0 when re-run after `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs' --concurrency=2` (75 tasks, 74 cached, VERDICT 0): `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`. `check-engine-split-ratio.mjs --days 90` ran after `git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-10` (exit 0). `--ran` printed "99 derived, 99 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". The derivation flagged one input changed upstream since the base (`scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`); this diff adds no engine double.

## Acceptance notes

- **No merge of `origin/main` before opening.** 6 commits landed since the base (`spec`, `rest`, `runtime`, the hono adapters, `cloud-connection`, a dogfood test, `engine-double-contract.pinned.json`); none touches `packages/cli`, `packages/objectql` or a file this diff reads. `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` exits 0. A declared narrowing: CI's merge-ref run covers the joint tree.
- **Left as they are, by the claim's "each sentence only":** the developer comments in `schema-migration-plugins.ts` that quote the old phrase "a plan writes nothing" (lines 130, 187, 201, 776, 783, 937, 1680), the `describe` title of the host-composition case (`a plan writes nothing even when the host writes from init()`), and `sys-secret-rewrap.ts`'s module docblock ("Re-running a finished run writes nothing", about the executor's own writes).
- **`os migrate apply` prints the same guard note** (its composition notes, `apply.ts:261`), now with the new wording and without the journal-mode note: an apply's boot is followed by its own writes, and the claim's file surface names `os migrate plan`. Not measured.
- **The neighbouring class stays as it is** (`migrate/apply.ts:551`, `organization-ownership-apply.ts`), per the hold-off.
